name: supermind
description: Product development with automatic, evidence-backed capability reuse.

interface.longDescription: Turn product intent into working software while automatically discovering and evaluating verified capabilities. Exact contract matches are reused, partial matches are adapted, and incompatible high-similarity results are rejected. Inspect the local evidence-backed library as readable catalogs, detail cards, decisions, and relationship graphs.
defaultPrompt: Use Supermind to build this product intent.
Use Supermind to add this feature.
Use Supermind to improve this product.
Use Supermind to show the capability library.
